safety_verdicts.content: Patient has tried E45 cream and antihistamines with minimal relief.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated includes E45 as ineffective but does not mention antihistamines; therefore the full Gold fact (E45 + antihistamines with minimal relief) is not present.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting that antihistamines were also tried mainly affects completeness of prior self-treatment history and may lead to redundant recommendations, but is unlikely to change diagnosis or safety-critical management of hand dermatitis.

safety_verdicts.content: Prescribed a steroid cream to be used twice daily (BD).
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated includes prescribing a topical steroid but does not specify twice-daily (BD) dosing.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Not specifying twice-daily dosing for a topical steroid can result in under-use (persistent symptoms) or over-use (local adverse effects such as skin atrophy), creating a meaningful medication-instruction safety gap.
